description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje apartament 3+1 ne Yzberisht, kompleksi i pallateve Cabej. 
Pjese e nje ndertimi me ashensor, kati i dyte. 
I organizuar ne korridorin shperndares, tualet dite, holli me dalje ne ballkon si dhe tre dhoma gjumi.
description_en: We offer for sale a 3+1 apartment in Yzberisht, Cabej building complex. Part of a building with an elevator, second floor. Organized in the distribution corridor, day toilet, hall with access to the balcony and three bedrooms.
